# Deer stew

Type: Food | Internal ID: DeerStew | Source: Cauldron | Usage: Crafting, Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Cooked deer meat x1, Blueberries x1, Carrot x1 | Max Health: 45 | Max Stamina: 15 | Duration: 25m | Healing: 3 hp/tick

# Introduction

Deer stew is a Black Forest-tier food.

## Recipe

Deer stew is produced in a level 1 Cauldron with:
• 1 Cooked deer meat
• 1 Blueberries
• 1 Carrot

### Crafting

• Black Forest buffet platter

## Notes

• Deer stew provides the highest health gain in the Black Forest, at 45.
